exposure: hepatitis B immunoglobulin administration at birth
outcome: child HBV infection (chronic hepatitis B, HBsAg positive)
cohort: A cohort of 654 children was assessed, including 148 children who tested positive for chronic hepatitis B and a control group of 418 vaccinated children.
finding: The study identified potential correlations between birth type and vaccination status with childhood HBV infection, highlighting the necessity of diligent monitoring and treatment of pregnant women with HBV to prevent vertical transmission.
mod_finding: Among the 148 HBV-positive children, 80.4% were delivered naturally; additionally, 4 of the 5 children who received hepatitis B immunoglobulin at birth and were HBV-positive were born via cesarean section.
